card.title: How To Fix iPhone X That Does Not Charge

source.title: How To Fix iPhone X That Does Not Charge

claims.statement: Liquid on the iPhone X earpiece flex (flood illuminator and ALS) can short data lines and cause no charging or bootloops; the flex is paired for Face ID, so clean or transfer the sensors to keep Face ID.
Most iPhone X no-charge cases are fixed by replacing Tigris U3300; test with only top board, battery, port and screen.
If still not charging, replace Tigris coils L3340 and L3341; rarely Hydra is the cause.

procedure: Unplug all but screen, port and battery; test known-good parts.
Inspect earpiece flex sensors for corrosion.
Split the sandwich; test top board alone.
Replace Tigris U3300, then L3340/L3341, then Hydra.
